summary: Frontend-only regression of the 3 fixes from this iteration (transparent logo on login page + removal of the settings gear from all 3 sub-app headers). All 5 requested verifications PASS. (1) On https://chef-tasks.preview.emergentagent.com/ with empty localStorage, login-view renders and img[alt=NeoChef] loads /neochef-logo.png with HTTP 200, naturalWidth/naturalHeight = 1024x1024, complete=true, no broken-image icon. Asset verified server-side too: /app/frontend/build/neochef-logo.png == /app/scripts/neochef-logo.png (md5 341600d6..., 400520 bytes), PNG mode RGBA, alpha extrema (0,255), corner and top-edge pixels are (0,0,0,0) -> the previously reported opaque black matte is GONE and the logo now blends into the dark-navy/teal gradient (screenshot 01_login_logo). (2) Logged in as groupenaga@gmail.com/LeCercle123! -> module-view; opened /menu/, /taches/ and /events/: locator('[data-testid=settings-dropdown-button]').count() == 0 in all three, an explicit DOM scan for gear glyphs (U+2699 / Ionicons private-use codepoints) returned [] in all three, and the enumeration of interactive elements in the top 110px of each header contains only the hamburger (left:16) and the restaurant logo + restaurant-selector chevron (left:947, centered) — top-right of the header is empty. Header screenshots confirm visually. (3) Landing 'Paramètres' tile still navigates to /menu/#settings and renders the full settings section (Logo du restaurant, Nom du restaurant = O'Parloir, Contact, QR code, Themes) — no regression. (4) After localStorage.clear() + reload the login screen shows again with the logo at naturalWidth 1024 (session-restore/cache-bust path OK). No console errors observed; sub-app console output only shows normal data-loading logs. Backend testing skipped per request.
